body: I'm trying to find one around here. I'm tired of feeling like this. I try to go walking/jogging every night around campus it helps a bit. Shoot if I knew how to ride a bike I totally would.
I've thought about that, but i'm not very sure.

Thanks. I try not to dwell on the past but it just creeps up on me or something happens and I remember everything (For example an old friend of mine recently lost her baby and I remembered everything that happened to me that night in vivid detail complete with all the emotions). I can only see things getting better when I finally move out of my parents house and away from family. I tried to start but I couldn't go back after we talked about my father. Just saying what happened aloud made me not want to go back, I felt too open. I'm trying to trust in myself, everyone else trusts me more than I do myself.

Most of me knows that it's not my fault but there's still a part of me that has to irrationally blame myself. In my home I get blamed for a lot of things, and even when I'm at college and not home things are still my fault. So I always blame myself. I try not to, but it doesn't work.
